name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Styled Solid tooltip component backed by Keystone overlay positioning and Escape dismissal.

meta.customization: Style the generated wrappers through mason-tooltip classes while Keystone owns positioning and trigger/content relationships.

parity.baseUi: Thin vertical covers trigger/content relationship, controlled open state, delay intent, Escape dismissal, floating placement, portal rendering, and Mason classes. Gaps: provider-level delay groups, arrow geometry, hoverable content policy, transition status metadata, disabled trigger handling, and full focus manager coverage remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Matches Solid Tooltip/Popper direction with trigger, portal/content, open delays, controlled state, and aria-describedby wiring. Gaps: skip-delay-duration groups, forceMount transition lifecycle, arrow part, and advanced pointer safe-area behavior remain follow-up work.
